title: VNC: Remove globals
description:
The bytes_per_pixel and depth values are per connection. Setting
them as globals breaks dissection when there are multiple VNC
connections in a single capture.

Set the conversation data bytes_per_pixel and depth data on the
first pass. For each packet, set the packet level data on the first
pass to the conversation level state at that point. Use the value
set to packet level data on subsequent passes. The preferred_encoding
value doesn't seem to be used, so only have it in conversation data
instead of storing it in each packet.

Update some comments to refer to RFC 6143 (which is where the URL
for the spec host at http://www.realvnc.com now redirects to anyway.)
